capabilities: Carry incomplete tasks from previous daily and weekly notes into new ones
Mark carried-over tasks in the previous note with a custom status character
Add due dates to copied tasks for tracking with the Tasks plugin
Restrict task collection to specific headers in periodic notes
Sync all vault tasks into an auto-created Kanban board
disambiguation: Not a standalone task manager; it only moves incomplete tasks between periodic notes and a Kanban board.
extras: Designed for Obsidian 1.13.0 or later; without Periodic Notes installed, it falls back to Obsidian defaults or Calendar plugin settings for daily and weekly notes.
intentEvidence: Combine periodic notes with tags and tasks to automatically manage your daily, weekly and project TODO lists.
problem: Obsidian periodic notes leave incomplete tasks behind, so unfinished items from yesterday's or last week's note must be copied forward by hand.

relations.evidence: When the Periodic Notes plugin is installed, this plugin respects its settings
Adds a due date to copied tasks so they can be appropriately tracked in the Tasks plugin
All the tasks within the periodic notes and elsewhere in the vault can be collated and centralised into a Kanban board
This plugin works well with the Auto Periodic Notes plugin.

summary: Task carry-over plugin that copies incomplete tasks into the next daily or weekly note and can sync vault tasks to a Kanban board.
